text: …　…　…　おお　そうか　わしが　よんだのじゃった！

structure.jp: わしが　よんだのじゃった！
structure.en: it was me who called you!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives the explanation for a situation; in the past it shows he has just remembered. じゃった is the old-man way of saying だった. よんだのじゃった = 'I was the one who called you'.
